text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Got a look at your training!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
From my judgment,
<chrname> still has lots of 
hidden potential.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Wanna see—what lies beyond!! Definitely 
let me join your training!

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text:
Don't hold back!
I'll be collecting plenty 
of data! Dahahahaha!!
